name: Install Android SDK (retry)
command: set -e; D=~/.local/share/open-teams-android; cd $D; export JAVA_HOME=$D/jdk17 PATH=$D/unzip/bin:$PATH; mkdir -p sdk/cmdline-tools; rm -rf sdk/cmdline-tools/latest sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools; unzip -q clt.zip -d sdk/cmdline-tools; mv sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools sdk/cmdline-tools/latest; yes | sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$D/sdk --licenses >/dev/null; sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$D/sdk "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" | tail -3; ls sdk
